event_group: original any_hit: both, TimesFM_only, TimeRadar_only, neither; original independent one_to_one matching retained separately

phases.pre_normal: max(start-512, previous original event end) to start, legal scored normal points only
phases.steady_after512: start+512 to end; same existing long-event definition
phases.recovery_32: end to min(end+32,next original event start), normal points only
phases.recovery_32_512: end+32 to min(end+512,next original event start), normal points only

quantiles: all nine stored marginal levels .1 to .9; native q10-q90 width and inclusive coverage only; equality and zero widths explicit
concentration: per-point squared-error shares; largest1/largest3; inverse Herfindahl effective channel count; minimum channels explaining50/80%; zero-total-error NA
statistics: point mean/p10/median/p90; event-macro means separately from pooled event-phase exposures; no pooling domains or significance claims
normal_fragments: consecutive original model alarm AND normal label; reset at index gaps/attack boundaries; no new OR alarm
normal_labels: posthoc nominal normal annotation, not certified operating states
